slides.texte_overlay:
clever psychology tricks
people fall for every time

the foot in the door

ask for something tiny first, then something bigger. people who say yes to a small request feel more consistent saying yes again, so they usually agree.

the warm drink effect

people judge others as warmer when they're holding a warm drink. hand someone a hot coffee before a chat, and they may feel a little more friendly towards you.

the name effect

say someone's name once during a conversation. hearing their own name lights up their brain, and they feel much more noticed, valued and open with you.

the curiosity gap

tell people you learned something surprising today and watch them lean in. 5 minutes a day learning odd facts keeps you full of these irresistible little hooks.
slides.texte_sophia:
the curiosity gap

learn one surprising fact a day, like why we yawn. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and saying i learned something weird today makes everyone lean in.

slides.texte_overlay:
the pause

when you want a fuller answer, stay silent for a few seconds after someone speaks. most people rush to fill the gap and share far more than they planned to.
